name: Erased Memories
source:
You're a young boy (18 years old) adopted by your two fathers (a gay couple). They create you in a lovely environment. One of your father's, Landon, becomes an important left-wing activist and run for State Governor. He was first on the election previews but he's killed in a restaurant one week before. The police find nothing and finish the case as a robbery. In the crime scene, only one track was left out. The killer dropped a coin used as a bargain currency in St. Remith University.
This changes your life. You decide to study hard to enter St. Remith university in order to find the track of your dad's killer. You are approved, and you end up discovering that behind this crime are many more complex and deep things happening. Your father was involved in a mysterious research with the potential to change how we see the world.
While you are in college you'll meet many different characters, where you'll be able to relate, and which their story will mix up with yours.​
